name: Write creative and descriptive essays on various topics
description: Users requested the generation of essays, compositions, or short pieces of writing on a diverse range of topics, including personal narratives, literary analysis, and social issues. These requests often included specific constraints regarding word count, language level, tone, or stylistic devices, distinguishing them from requests for structured academic arguments or standard exam prompts.
